prose.text: The block runs, in order: - the formatter and the linter; - the rig's library unit cases with `--no-fail-fast`, then the workspace unit layer (the `keep-version` control's   entry); - the rig rehearsals by binary; - the live round: the wrapped local rehearsal, the install read, the census, the build, the sandbox probe, the host   read, the scratch base read, `SF`, the census, `SF-2` (conditional, §E), then the operator-keyed census; - the whole integration and E2E layers; - the operator pass.

What is not run, and why: - No smoke entry: no boot-path file changes. The fake agent's new option is argv-only and draws no new screen, so   `cli_verify`'s recorded-screen cases are untouched; they run inside the whole integration layer all the same. - No release check: `viola-e2e` and the fake agent are test-only, refused by `scripts/release-check.sh`, and the   product graph is unchanged. - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 9).

Bounds and homes: - The rehearsals wait through the file's existing helpers (`WITHIN` 18 s), under the integration profile's kill.   The `sf` rehearsals pass `--deadline 15` as `Case::rig` does. The unit cases do not wait. - The live `SF` passes `--deadline 900` under its entry's `timeout` 1200. The arm's `SF_TURN_BOUND` of 480 s holds   the CLI's retries with room: one to three minutes expected, static, never measured. - Every rehearsal runs under its case's own `/tmp` root. The live start runs under the rig's private scratch at   `/tmp/viola-rig-<uid>/`, which names no `home` component.

**What the contained child can still write outside the scratch** (`inputs#I3` item 7): - The sandbox binds the whole filesystem read-write except three places:   - `/run/systemd/resolve`: hidden;   - `/tmp`: a private tmpfs, gone with the sandbox, so the CLI's OS-temp files never reach the host's `/tmp`;   - the scratch root: rebound, so its own files land where the teardown removes them. - So the child can still write any path the operator's uid can write outside `/tmp`:   - the real `~/.claude.json` — the CLI reads the private config under `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, so it is not expected     to write here;   - the rest of `~/.claude*` and other files under the home (the CLI's own caches or state, unmeasured);   - `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` (viola's socket directory, where `viola run` binds and removes its socket). - The witnesses read afterwards:   - the user-config stamp before and after (`user-config:`); `lacks user-config: unread` and `lacks     changed-by-rig` are stopping reds, `changed-by-others` a reading;   - the rig's process census (`census: 0`, and the operator-keyed census after the last leg);   - `scratch: absent`. - No witness reads the CLI's own writes under the home outside `~/.claude.json`. They are named here as the   residual every private-config start already carries (the arch history's accepted CLI residual class), never   claimed absent.

The live legs' non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of `SF`: the install read by path, the census, the build with its hashes, the sandbox probe on a no-op child, the host read and the scratch base read. None primes anything. The wrapped local rehearsal is the entry the live start rests on (`inputs#I3` item 5).

**The remove-the-guard controls** are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)). Each reads «holds» only when its case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line; a `timeout` reading is not «holds», and neither is an entry that is merely red.

| Control | File | The edit removes | Case | Fired on | Timeout | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | `keep-version` | `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/isolate.rs` | `keep_record`'s per-version refusal (§A.1); implement quotes the exact text in the control record | `rig::isolate::tests::keep_record_refuses_a_standing_version_and_writes_nothing` | entry 4 (`bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --unit`, a workspace-building layer: testing.md 2026-11-13) | `--timeout 2400` | | `sandbox-refusal` | `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/mod.rs` | the `refused: sandbox` return before the ledger line (§C.5) | `rig_rehearsal_sf_refuses_contain_without_the_sandbox_before_its_ledger_line` | entry 5 (the harness's integration layer, which builds the workspace) | `--timeout 2400` |
